title: assign_number races under concurrent pool connections
description: reader/src/store/article_numbers.rs:26-64: assign_number uses a DEFERRED SQLite transaction that reads SELECT MAX(article_number) then INSERTs. With a pool that has max_connections > 1, two concurrent calls for the same group both read the same MAX and both attempt to INSERT (group_name, same_number). The second INSERT hits the PRIMARY KEY constraint and returns Err(sqlx::Error::Database). The caller receives an unexpected DB error and the article number assignment silently fails. The tests use max_connections(1) which hides this. Fix: use an EXCLUSIVE transaction (BEGIN EXCLUSIVE), or use INSERT OR IGNORE followed by SELECT to make the operation idempotent, or add explicit retry logic on UNIQUE violation.
notes: CONFIRMED THEORETICAL: server_stores.rs creates the pool with max_connections(1). assign_number is only called sequentially in a for-loop in log_append.rs. No concurrent assign_number calls are possible. The PRIMARY KEY constraint would also catch the race if it could occur. Downgrading to P3 or close as won't-fix.
